thread:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the authz outage this morning — consolidated action list below. Please ack and update your ticket/PR by EOD Wed. Main points: token validation hotfix, audit logging gaps, permissions drift, and secrets rotation scheduling.

Oliver: Acked. I can own the token validation hotfix. Will open a PR and target a canary deploy tomorrow morning. ETA: 24h.

Juan: I will take audit logging. Observed missing grant/revoke events for service tokens — likely schema mismatch in the logging pipeline. Need a short schema change + backfill plan.

Samira: I’ll run a RBAC scan across services and list principals with admin-ish access. Propose adding a weekly cron job to detect perms drift.

Alex: I’ll coordinate secrets rotation. We should pick a 2h maintenance window (low traffic) and rotate staged by env. I need help with the runbook for fallout scenarios.

Lena: Thank you. For rollout, prefer canary -> region-wide -> global. Also require audit events for token invalidate actions (so we can trace).

Maya: Added owners to the tracker and linked tickets: INC-4023 (token-hotfix) / INC-4024 (audit-logging) / INC-4025 (perms-audit) / INC-4026 (secrets-rotation). Please add PR/issue links in the ticket comments.

DevOps Bot: Created ticket INC-4023: "token validation hotfix" (assignee: Oliver). https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4023

Oliver: Quick note on the hotfix: root cause was lenient JWT validation for legacy tokens where aud claim was missing. Proposed diff:
```
- validate(aud) || legacy_mode
+ validate(aud) && reject_if_missing
```
Will include a compatibility wrapper and feature flag for canary.

Juan: For logging pipeline backfill: I can run a one-off job to rehydrate events from S3 if we agree on the schema. Pushing a schema draft to INC-4024 in 2 hours.

Samira: RBAC scan plan: use rbac-scan v0.9, run against all prod service accounts, output CSV -> owners notified. Propose weekly job name: infra-perms-drift.

Alex: Secrets rotation runbook draft:
- phase 1: rotate in staging (confirm no auth regressions)
- phase 2: rotate prod non-critical services
- phase 3: rotate critical services with canary traffic
Fallback: rollback rotation keys + immediate invalidation of newly issued tokens.

Maya: Two follow-up asks: (1) owners to add expected ETA to their ticket comments, (2) we collect one example audit trace after each step to validate observability.

Lena: Also flagging a recurring pattern: we keep seeing tokens minted prior to key rotations still accepted because we lack token invalidation hooks. Long-term action: add token revocation list and make key rotation emit revoke events. Adding that as backlog item.

Oliver: Agree on revocation list — adding design note to INC-4023 backlog. Might require a tiny cache + publish-subscribe to invalidate caches.

Samira: For perms drift detection, I'll add a Slack alert in #eng-sre when a service account gains elevated roles.

Alex: I'll sync with infra tomorrow 09:30 to lock rotation window. Adding runbook link to INC-4026.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If you can't meet the ETA, ping me ASAP. Will run a 15m sync tomorrow 10:00 to check progress. :thumbsup:
